description: Date that is N business days after (or before, with negative days) a start date: settlement and value dates (T+1 = 1, T+2 = 2), payment due dates, deadlines. days = 0 rolls a non-business start forward to the next business day. Lists every non-business day skipped and why. calendars: one or more calendar codes from list_calendars, e.g. ["USD.FX", "EUR.FX"] for a EUR/USD FX trade, ["XNYS.SETTLE"] for NYSE settlement, ["TARGET2.PAY"] for euro payments, ["GBLON.BANK"] for London banks. A date counts as a business day only when it is open in every calendar given. date defaults to today.
name: add_business_days
title: Add business days (T+N date)
